source: Pinned 15 October production database archive restored to a disposable, network-isolated PostgreSQL container
scope: Drummonds active canonical jobs, aggregate counts only
boundary: This is a point-in-time historical archive, not current LIVE coverage. Later LIVE job intake includes newer unlinked work, so these counts cannot establish present-day link completeness. The direct-communication count checks interactions.related_job_id only; other customer-linked communications may exist but are not evidence of an explicit job link. Absence of a zoned completed_date prevents duration scoring and does not deny the saved completed status. Engineer-person absence is not a complete measure of team routing.
